_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), by the folds. 2: folded once or into a quarter with holes only; 3: a quarter fold with cuts on the folds, folds along diagonals, or three folds with holes; 4: folded in three, holes through extra layers, or several cuts and holes opened through three or more folds. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
